name: Atheist
overview: Scripture clearly identifies atheism as a denial of God's existence, describing such individuals as fools who reject God in their hearts and engage in corrupt and abominable works (Psalms 14:1; Psalms 10:4). The Bible warns that God's wrath is revealed against all ungodliness and unrighteousness, including those who suppress the truth about God (Romans 1:18). Believers are called to stand firmly on God as their rock and salvation (Psalms 62:6) and to recognize that neutrality is impossible in the spiritual battle, for one is either with Christ or against Him (Matthew 12:30). Furthermore, Scripture admonishes believers to avoid contemptuous attitudes toward others, as anger and insults can bring severe judgment (Matthew 5:22).
